article.title: Uyghur genocide psy-op exposed
article.author: Jeremy Kuzmarov
article.content: The Uyghur genocide allegations draw on racist yellow-peril caricatures that first gained prominence in the 19 th century as part of a Sinophobic campaign directed against Chinese migrant laborers. The post Uyghur genocide psy-op exposed appeared first on MR Online .
